title: Fall Seven Times, Rise Eight | A Discipline Short Film
lines: He fell. Again. Seven times this year.
Each fall felt like the end.
But he got up. Slower, maybe. Bruised, definitely.
Falling is not failing. Staying down is.
Every great story has a chapter where it almost ends.
Rise eight. Always one more than you fall.
They don't remember how many times you fell. Only that you got up.
